claims.description: Modun overran Gewutu and his people.
Nieli enthroned Huaixiu as Zuwu Khan.
Kailuo replaced Huaixiu after Huaixiu rebelled against Tang.
They jointly rebelled against Tang and seized Yingzhou.
Zhang Shougui installed Guozhe and enfeoffed him as Prince of Beiping.
Nieli killed Guozhe and destroyed his household.
